four_layer_diagnosis.claim_alignment: n/a (claim-free diagnostic). The pre-registered rule is honoured and the label stands: strict single-class latching (>= 0.95 of fresh decisions) holds on 2/8 seeds, and the readout is not degenerate (shares 0.41-1.0). But the reading is BAR-SENSITIVE (flip at 0.75-0.78), and under a dominance reading the run REPRODUCES 983a's picture on 5/8 seeds: stay-dominant seeds die (42 at 0.76, 123 at 0.78, 23 at 0.99), constant-move-dominant seeds survive (456 at 0.85 on class 3 = right; 31 at 1.0 on class 1 = down); on 42/123/23 the majority of episodes (22/40, 24/40, 39/40) consist of STAY at BOTH fresh decisions and last exactly as long as the STAY control (10.0/12.0/11.0 steps). Three diverse casualties (7 at 0.41, 11 at 0.42, 17 at 0.52) are explained by neither reading. What the label's inference ('stage 2 proceeds') licenses is discussed under routing: the ratified stage 2 is runnable as designed; this run prices its seed draw.
four_layer_diagnosis.biological_reference: clear -- basal-ganglia action selection over a passive-avoidance substrate (targeted_review_ext_002; targeted_review_commit_release_duration_latch for the hold). The cells implicate the SELECTION face, as 983a inferred, not the hold duration: harm-on-held share (0.65-0.85 across the six casualties) equals or sits slightly BELOW the held-tick share of realised steps (0.82-0.89) -- the base rate of a ~10-step hold schedule -- and per-tick harm is LOWER on held ticks than on fresh ticks on every casualty (e.g. 0.78 vs 0.98 on seed 42; 0.11 vs 0.47 on seed 11; robust to removing step-0 ticks on 5/6). The pure-STAY episodes show E3 re-deliberating at step 10 and choosing STAY again. The lethal choice is a fresh STAY selection on a proximity-harm field; the hold reproduces it, it does not create it (red-team F2).

four_layer_diagnosis.implementation: partial -- the actor. Strict latching (>= 0.95) holds on 2/8 and splits 1 die (23, on STAY) / 1 survive (31, a constant down-mover, 8000/8000 steps of class 1, 200/200 survival at the CONSTANT_1 control's harm rate 0.015); the six non-latched seeds split 5 die / 1 survive. Casualty longevity orders with falling STAY share (23 0.98 < 42 0.75 < 123 0.74 < 17 0.41 ~ 7 0.38 < 11 0.003; mean steps 11 / 12 / 14 / 21 / 22 / 85), so STAY share, not fresh-decision diversity, is the recorded correlate of death; survivors execute STAY on 0/7794 and 0/8000 steps. No executed histogram is close to uniform (42: 25/75 over two classes; 7: 1/21/40/38; 17: 56/3/41; 11: 31/44/0/25/0), so 'the executed policy is a random walk' is not supported by the histograms.
four_layer_diagnosis.environment: adequate-but-unforgiving, not the lever (unchanged from 983a): CONSTANT_0..3 survive 200/200 on all 8 boards at harm 0.0-0.015; STAY dies on all 8 in 10-14 steps at harm 1.0; RANDOM_WALK dies on all 8 in 11-17 steps at harm 0.65-0.88. The boards do not discriminate seeds; the policy does.
four_layer_diagnosis.measurement: adequate for the pre-registered statistic, with two limits. (i) The closest_control_profile match (driver L505-507: hypot over (steps difference)/200 and harm-rate difference) is decided by harm rate alone for any dying policy -- the steps term is <= 0.035 -- so a 75%-STAY agent at harm 0.81 is labelled RANDOM_WALK (0.73) rather than STAY (1.0); the profile carries no mechanism information and must not be read as 'behaviourally a random walk' (red-team F4). (ii) The 79-85% harm-on-held figure is structural to a 10-step hold schedule (same lesson as V3-EXQ-999a red-team F2: a readout tied to the hold schedule is confounded with the schedule for any agent) and discriminates nothing. What the run records that DOES discriminate: the executed-class histogram, per-tick harm on held vs fresh ticks, and the per-episode fresh histogram aligned to survival -- all present in the flat JSON.
four_layer_diagnosis.integration: partially coupled -- residue accumulates on every harm (residue_harm_events == harm_events) yet E3 re-selects STAY at the next fresh decision on the same board; whether residue can shift a fresh selection is exactly stage 2's question and is untested here.
four_layer_diagnosis.scale: adequate -- 8/8 seeds adjudicable (82-840 fresh decisions each), 40 episodes x 200 steps planned; 3 control episodes per policy per board.

learning_extracted: Strict single-class latching (>= 0.95 of fresh decisions) is refuted as the survival lever on 6/8 seeds under the pre-registered rule -- but the rule is bar-sensitive (label flips at 0.75-0.78), and under a dominance reading 983a's picture (stay-dominant seeds die; constant-move-dominant seeds survive) holds on 5/8. State the bar sensitivity beside the label; do not convert a strict-bar null into 'the predecessor named the wrong mechanism'.

The 79-85% harm-on-held-tick figure is the base rate of a ~10-step hold schedule (held-tick share 0.82-0.89) and discriminates nothing; per-tick harm is LOWER on held ticks than on fresh ticks on every casualty, and on seeds 42/123/23 the majority of episodes are STAY at both fresh decisions with the STAY control's exact survival. The recorded cells lean to the SELECTION face, not the hold duration. A readout tied to the hold schedule is confounded with the schedule for any agent (999a red-team F2).

The closest_control_profile yardstick is decided by harm rate alone when every policy dies (steps term <= 0.035), so a 75%-STAY agent at harm 0.81 is labelled RANDOM_WALK; it must not be read as 'the executed policy is a random walk' -- no executed histogram in the run is near uniform. The discriminating recordings are the executed-class histogram, per-tick harm on held vs fresh ticks, and the per-episode fresh histogram aligned to survival, all now in the flat JSON.

The casualty set is IDENTICAL to 983a's six excluded seeds (steps_realized_frac agreeing to two decimals). 983a's ratified stage 2 already anticipated this -- 'seeds drawn until MIN_POOLED_SEEDS 3 is met', per-seed divergence and diversity gates, DV per unit exposure -- so the finding prices the draw (~1/8 per seed under the gates; ~27-38 h) rather than blocking the design. The selection effect (the pooled population will be constant-mover seeds) is governance's to accept or reject explicitly.

Casualty longevity orders with falling STAY share (23 0.98 -> 11 0.003: 11 -> 85 mean steps); the most diverse casualty is the longest-lived. 'Diversity does not protect' is true of full-budget survival on these boards (constant movers only), not of longevity.
